summary: 30-year-old backcountry skier carried 1,800 ft by an avalanche in the 'Oh What Big Eyes You Have' couloir on Red Mountain and killed.
location: North side of Red Mountain, Gore Range (Red Peak, ~12,885 ft), north of Silverthorne
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group; Summit County Sheriff; Summit County Coroner
notes: Aaron Wiener, 30, of Denver; party of three experienced backcountry skiers; triggered a small wind pocket; body recovery delayed to Friday due to weather/hazard; 5th CO avalanche fatality of the 2019-20 season. CAIC classic 2019-20 season table confirms: "Point 12885 near Red Peak, west of Silverthorne," 2 tourers caught and carried, 1 killed; CAIC final report: Skier 1 swept the couloir length (~1,600 ft) and did not survive (Red Mountain/Red Peak naming both refer to the Gore Range near Silverthorne). UN Red Mountain avalanche-death account merged run 540. run 671: SnowBrains Red Mountain couloir article, parent-opened SnowBrains merge run 885: CAIC final report — skier-triggered wind-slab (SS-ASu-R2-D2-I); Skier 1 carried ~1,600 ft down the "Oh What Big Eyes You Have" couloir; body retrieved April 17 by SCRG/SCSO/Flight for Life.
